title: Choose the new look for the spa demo
question: Three directions for the dashboard. Pick one to build across all 10 screens, or re-roll.

options.label: Pandan & Calamansi
options.lineage: Filipino botanical product labels (pandan, calamansi, coconut, kraft)
options.thesis: The front desk feels like a fresh local botanical label, not an admin template.
options.viewport: Pandan-green side rail, airy coconut-white work area; today's bookings lead, each service category marked by its label colour band.
options.risk: Green can read 'health clinic' if the calamansi and amber notes are too timid.

raised.raise: Cancelled and no-show bookings stay visible, stamped and struck, never silently removed.
Colour only does a job (service category, booking state, money up/down), never decoration.
One type family and hairline rules carry the whole system; no extra card chrome.

options.label: Banig Weave
options.lineage: Filipino woven banig mats (dyed pandan and buri strips)
options.thesis: Therapists and hours cross like woven strips; the schedule is the signature.
options.viewport: Teal top bar, today's schedule as a woven therapist-by-hour grid across the top half, money and stock below.
options.risk: Familiar 'local heritage' move; stripes tip into souvenir costume if overused.

options.label: Jet-age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each booking as a coupon that gets stamped.
options.case: Spa owners don't recognise themselves in air travel; reads as a costume.
options.kept: States stamp onto the record instead of vanishing.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.case: Dark ground breaks your 'not dark or heavy' rule.
options.kept: One consistent colour per series across every chart.

options.label: Lexicon Plate
options.thesis: Black text, colour only inside plates.
options.case: Bookish and cream; the exact look you are leaving.
options.kept: Colour is quarantined to where it means something.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.case: Clean but cold; no spa warmth.
options.kept: One type family and hairline discipline.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Letters built on a visible grid.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Barcode fields in black and white.
options.kept: Numbers set in strict tabular columns.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What Fresha or Boulevard ship: white, one soft brand colour, clean sans.
canonCard.viewport: Light sidebar, white cards, KPI row, calendar strip and list.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every booking app; nothing says 'built for your spa'.
